purpose: The External Capability Catalog. Baltor domain code depends on a capability_slot, never a vendor. Each slot carries the currently-wired adapter (a working stdlib stub today), a candidate primary external repo, fallbacks, an I/O contract, contract proofs, license, and health. A 3rd-party dependency CANNOT land without a card here. Builds ON data/backend-tools.yaml (the verified seed) — its 13 keys are mirrored as slots; the flagged block is mirrored into quarantined_providers and a drift proof keeps them in sync.
